description.value: Dreamcycle Motorcycle Museum in Sorrento houses one of Canada's most unique and diverse collections of over 100 historic motorbikes, each selected for its story and displayed as a work of art spanning more than a century of motorcycle history. Situated directly on the Trans-Canada Highway in the Shuswap, it is a natural waypoint for touring cyclists passing through the region. The museum offers virtual-headset and live guided tours, a gift shop, and an on-site café.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is well-populated and confirms a real, operating attraction at 3096 Trans-Canada Highway, Sorrento, BC, with phone (250) 253-5094 on the Contact page. The Sprokkets Cafe is confirmed via multiple passages ('sandwich at our popular cafe,' 'Sprokkets Cafe that is filled with homemade sandwiches and delicious baked items, baked daily'). No website or OSM evidence mentions bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, showers, or any other cyclist-specific amenities, so these remain null.
